what: Hand-written held-out routing set: 50 agents, 72 follow-ups, written in one sitting before any run and never used for tuning. Kinds and the pass bar are fixed here.

expectations.notes: typo and paraphrase are the kinds the roster's lexical matching is weakest on; the trigram fallback ships off. If the fork lands below a bar the README reports it as a miss, not a tuning target.
